free_tier.stated: approx. 1 MiB per paste (measured: 1,040,000 chars accepted, 1,133,336 chars -> HTTP 413). No account, no quota, no count limit observed.

egress.terms: free direct GET, no metering, no redirect; pastes served as HTML with a raw path.

tooling: curl -X POST -F 'format=url' -F 'content=<file' https://dpaste.org/api/ returns a plain URL. dpaste is the open-source Django app (github.com/bartTC/dpaste), so the same client works against any instance in the network.
chaining: unlimited anonymous pastes x ~1 MiB. Cross-instance: dpaste.org, dpaste.com, dpaste.de and any self-hosted dpaste all share one API shape, so the same shard writer hits N independent operators. 1 TiB = ~1M pastes; only sane as a metadata/thumbnail tier.
limits_note: ~1 MiB per paste; expiry options 1 hour to never; no delete without the deletion key; a report about excess use routes to the operator.
reliability_note: Stable across a dozen API calls with no throttling observed. The URL slug is only 4 characters by default (SLUG_LENGTH=4), so paste URLs are enumerable — do not treat content as private without local encryption.

evidence.proved: 'POST /api/ ... returns the full URL that snippet was created'; form parameters content, lexer
